name: RatingField
description: Rating bound to a `number | null` form field. Pair it with `ratingSchema()`.
signature: ({ label, hint, warning, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, ...control }: RatingFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Ids of elements that describe the rating, such as a hint. A Field adds its own message.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Choosing the current rating again, or pressing Delete or Backspace, clears it. Default false.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon, drawn outlined when empty and filled when chosen. Pass it without a size. Default a star.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: max
props.description: How many icons there are, and so the highest rating. Default 5.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: step
props.description: `1` chooses whole icons; `0.5` also chooses half of one. A read-only display ignores it and fills to the exact value. Default 1.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Words for a rating, such as "3 hearts out of 5". Default "3.5 of 5 stars".

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
